description: geodienste.ch hazard maps (Gefahrenkarten) download service is a hazard data portal run by Coordination Office for Geoinformation of the cantons (KGK). The page distributes the harmonised cantonal hazard maps (data model version 1.3) canton by canton as INTERLIS through an Atom feed and STAC, as GeoPackage and shapefile, and as WFS, WMS and OGC API Features services. Coverage: Switzerland, by canton. Formats and interfaces named: INTERLIS, GPKG, SHP, WFS, WMS. Access is restricted: some cantons release data only after approval and others make them freely available. The licence is: cantonal terms of use apply; no licence type named on the page. Caveats: release rules differ by canton, and the page names no licence type or update date; only cantons that already delivered data in the harmonised model are covered. It can support natural-hazard exposure checks of roads, railways and buildings in Switzerland. Related records: no directly related record is catalogued yet; the data are reached through the portal page linked here.
